entries.protect: Mael's exact mature face, pale hair silhouette, deep extended lunge and both shoes, black-and-bone tailored clothing, the single continuous sword and its present grip, the crimson contact line and TWO separated black tendon ends. Keep the creature's ivory leg joints and mask, black petal masses, glasshouse framing and restrained eerie palette. Do not alter the leg's current pose or claim the creature now collapses.
entries.surfaces: Especially the FLOOR: replace the paving's glitter, granular grit, little pebbles, repeated cracks and scratchy reflections with broad dry matte pale stone planes and a small number of meaningful joints, retaining shoe/tendon contact shadows. Simplify glasshouse foliage into grouped dark plant silhouettes; creature petals and leg armor lose pervasive vein lattices, tiny scars and thread webs while keeping major structural edges. Hair in broad elegant locks, precise eyes/lips retained. Keep the sophisticated fashion-horror rendering rather than converting to cartoon/vector/anime.
entries.reason: Root actual native and matched-phone inspection found competing all-over surface marks, especially ground, while subject/action appeal merits source-preserving refinement.

entries.protect: Orren's exact sculptural face and fierce expression, red/gray hair, planted twisting stance, both cleaver grips, complete blade beneath the boar-machine jaw, airborne creature legs and visible mechanical joints, tusk sweeping through the long groove, original warm rust/olive/cream palette and opaque PAINTED brush treatment. Preserve the large force-bearing dust wave and creature/body diagonal.
entries.surfaces: Especially ground and dust: replace pervasive little ground flecks, cracked ochre mottling and debris confetti with broad matte ochre planes and grouped directional dust shapes. Rust remains a few large patina patches, painted metal stays tactile, cloth and skin stay distinct. Retain deliberate broad brush edges; do not turn this into glossy anime, smooth plastic or photoreal CGI.
